```{r Load packages and data}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(lavaan)
library(semPlot)
library(DiagrammeR)

survey_dat2 <- read.csv("survey_dat2.csv")
```

```{r Clean Data}

#Make sure season is a factor
survey_dat2$season <- as.character(survey_dat2$season)

#Generate hunting index
survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_bush_pigs[survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_bush_pigs=="No"]<- 0
survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_bush_pigs[survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_bush_pigs=="Yes"] <- 1

survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_carnivores[survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_carnivores=="No"]<- 0
survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_carnivores[survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_carnivores=="Yes"] <- 1

survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_wild_birds[survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_wild_birds=="No"]<- 0
survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_wild_birds[survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_wild_birds=="Yes"] <- 1

survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_tenrecs[survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_tenrecs=="No"]<- 0
survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_tenrecs[survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_tenrecs=="Yes"] <- 1

survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_bush_pigs<- as.numeric(survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_bush_pigs)
survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_wild_birds<- as.numeric(survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_wild_birds)
survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_carnivores<- as.numeric(survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_carnivores)
survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_tenrecs<- as.numeric(survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_tenrecs)

survey_dat2$hunted_trapped <- as.integer(
  survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_bush_pigs == 1 |
  survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_lemurs == 1 |
  survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_carnivores == 1 |
  survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_wild_birds == 1|
   survey_dat2$hunted_trapped_tenrecs == 1 
)

#Select relevant covariates
survey_dat2 <- survey_dat2%>% dplyr::select(hunted_trapped, age, season, amount_vanilla_harvested, amount_vanilla_lost, village, house_sol, commercial_goods, gender, crops_vanilla, cert_member, log_commercial) %>% drop_na(age)

#Get village dummy variables
survey_dat2$villageMandena <- survey_dat2$village
survey_dat2$villageMandena[survey_dat2$villageMandena=="Mandena"] <- 1
survey_dat2$villageMandena[survey_dat2$villageMandena!="1"] <- 0
survey_dat2$villageMandena <- as.numeric(survey_dat2$villageMandena)
survey_dat2$villageSarahandrano <- survey_dat2$village
survey_dat2$villageSarahandrano[survey_dat2$villageSarahandrano=="Sarahandrano"] <- 1
survey_dat2$villageSarahandrano[survey_dat2$villageSarahandrano!="1"] <- 0
survey_dat2$villageSarahandrano <- as.numeric(survey_dat2$villageSarahandrano)

#Get dataframe that only includes people who had a vanilla harvest and prep for analysis
survey_dat3 <- survey_dat2 %>% filter(amount_vanilla_harvested > 0)
survey_dat3$log_vanilla <- scale(log(survey_dat3$amount_vanilla_harvested+1)) #variable for amount of vanilla harvested
survey_dat3$village <- as.factor(survey_dat3$village)
X <- model.matrix(~ village, data = survey_dat3)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
colnames(X)
survey_dat3x <- cbind(survey_dat3, X)
survey_dat3x$villageMandena <- as.factor(survey_dat3x$villageMandena)
survey_dat3x$villageSarahandrano <- as.factor(survey_dat3x$villageSarahandrano)
survey_dat3x$cert_member[survey_dat3x$cert_member=="Yes"] <- 1
survey_dat3x$cert_member[survey_dat3x$cert_member=="No"] <- 0
survey_dat3x$cert_member <- as.numeric(survey_dat3x$cert_member)


#Get dataframe that only includes people who lost part of their vanilla harvest and prepare for analysis
survey_dat4 <- survey_dat2 %>% filter(amount_vanilla_lost > 0)
survey_dat4$log_vanilla_lost <- scale(log(survey_dat4$amount_vanilla_lost+1))
survey_dat4$vanilla_pct_loss <- survey_dat4$amount_vanilla_lost/(survey_dat4$amount_vanilla_harvested + survey_dat4$amount_vanilla_lost) #proportion of crop lost 
survey_dat4$log_vanilla_pct_loss <- scale(log(survey_dat4$vanilla_pct_loss+1))

X <- model.matrix(~ village, data = survey_dat4)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
colnames(X)

survey_dat4x <- cbind(survey_dat4, X)
survey_dat4x$villageMandena <- as.factor(survey_dat4x$villageMandena)
survey_dat4x$villageSarahandrano <- as.factor(survey_dat4x$villageSarahandrano)
survey_dat4x$cert_member[survey_dat4x$cert_member=="Yes"] <- 1
survey_dat4x$cert_member[survey_dat4x$cert_member=="No"] <- 0
survey_dat4x$cert_member <- as.numeric(survey_dat4x$cert_member)
survey_dat4x$log_vanilla <- log(survey_dat4x$amount_vanilla_harvested+1)


```

```{r Vanilla Harvest Amount SEM}

# ---- 1) Define the SEM ----
model_multi <- '
  log_vanilla ~ d1*cert_member + villageSarahandrano + villageMandena

  log_commercial ~ a1*log_vanilla + g1*cert_member + villageSarahandrano + villageMandena
  house_sol      ~ a2*log_vanilla + g2*cert_member + villageSarahandrano + villageMandena

  log_commercial ~~ house_sol

  hunted_trapped ~ b1*log_commercial + b2*house_sol +
                   c*log_vanilla + h1*cert_member +
                   villageSarahandrano + villageMandena + gender + age

  # --- Indirect effects of log_vanilla ---
  ind_goods_van  := a1*b1
  ind_house_van  := a2*b2
  ind_total_van  := ind_goods_van + ind_house_van
  direct_van     := c
  total_van      := direct_van + ind_total_van

  # --- Indirect effects of cert_member ---
  # via mediators only
  ind_cert_goods_only := g1*b1
  ind_cert_house_only := g2*b2

  # via vanilla only
  ind_cert_van_only   := d1*c

  # via vanilla -> mediators (3-step)
  ind_cert_van_goods  := d1*a1*b1
  ind_cert_van_house  := d1*a2*b2

  # total indirect of cert_member (all pathways except direct)
  ind_cert_total := ind_cert_goods_only + ind_cert_house_only +
                    ind_cert_van_only + ind_cert_van_goods + ind_cert_van_house

  # direct + total effect of cert_member
  direct_cert := h1
  total_cert  := direct_cert + ind_cert_total
'


# ---- 2) Fit the SEM  ----
fit_multi <- sem(
  model_multi,
  data = survey_dat3x,
  ordered   = c("hunted_trapped"),
  estimator = "WLSMV"   
)

# ---- 3) Inspect effects ----
summary(fit_multi, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)

obs <- lavInspect(fit_multi, "sampstat")[[1]]
imp <- lavInspect(fit_multi, "implied")[[1]]
resid_mat <- obs - imp
resid_mat


# ---- 4) Plot

pe95 <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi, ci = TRUE, level = 0.95)
pe90 <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi, ci = TRUE, level = 0.90)

keep_labs <- c("ind_goods_van","ind_house_van","ind_total_van","direct_van","total_van")

eff95 <- pe95 %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, est, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(Estimate = est, CI95_Lower = ci.lower, CI95_Upper = ci.upper)

eff90 <- pe90 %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(CI90_Lower = ci.lower, CI90_Upper = ci.upper)

eff_df <- eff95 %>%
  left_join(eff90, by = "label") %>%
  mutate(
    Effect = dplyr::recode(label,
      ind_goods_van  = "Indirect: Goods",
      ind_house_van  = "Indirect: House Materials",
      ind_total_van  = "Total indirect",
      direct_van     = "Direct",
      total_van      = "Total"),
    # Order: show each mediator, then totals & direct
    Effect = factor(
      Effect,
      levels = c("Total","Direct",  "Total indirect", "Indirect: Goods","Indirect: House Materials")
    )
  ) %>% filter(Effect != "Total indirect")

eff_df <- eff_df %>%
  mutate(
    Effect = dplyr::recode(label,
      ind_goods_van  = "Indirect:\nGoods",
      ind_house_van  = "Indirect:\nHouse Materials",
      ind_total_van  = "Total\nindirect",
      direct_van     = "Direct",
      total_van      = "Total"
    ),
    Effect = factor(
      Effect,
      levels = c("Total","Direct", "Indirect:\nGoods","Indirect:\nHouse Materials",
                 "Total\nindirect")
    )
  )%>% filter(Effect != "Total\nindirect")


# --- 3) Plot: point estimates with 95% (wider) and 90% (narrower) CIs ---

harvest_plot <- ggplot(eff_df, aes(x = Effect, y = Estimate, color = Effect)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = CI95_Lower, ymax = CI95_Upper),
                linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = CI90_Lower, ymax = CI90_Upper),
                  linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs( x = NULL,
    y = "Effect of log(vanilla harvest)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)  # angle labels
  )+
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "black", "purple3", "blue"))


```

```{r Vanilla Binary SEM}

# ---- 1) Define the SEM  ----
model_multi_binary <- '
  # Mediators (parallel)
  log_commercial ~ a1*crops_vanilla +  villageSarahandrano + villageMandena
  house_sol      ~ a2*crops_vanilla +  villageSarahandrano + villageMandena
log_commercial ~~ house_sol
  # Outcome
  hunted_trapped ~ b1*log_commercial + b2*house_sol +
                   c*crops_vanilla +  villageSarahandrano + villageMandena + gender + age

  ind_goods  := a1*b1
  ind_house  := a2*b2

  # Total indirect, direct, and total effects
  ind_total := ind_goods + ind_house 
  direct    := c
  total     := direct + ind_total
'

# ---- 2) Fit the SEM  ----
fit_multi_binary <- sem(
  model_multi_binary,
  data = survey_dat2,
  ordered   = c("hunted_trapped"),
  estimator = "WLSMV"     
)

# ---- 3) Inspect effects ----
summary(fit_multi_binary, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)


# ---- 4) Plot

pe95_binary <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_binary, ci = TRUE, level = 0.95)
pe90_binary <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_binary, ci = TRUE, level = 0.90)

keep_labs <- c("ind_goods","ind_house","ind_total","direct","total")

eff95_binary <- pe95_binary %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, est, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(Estimate = est, CI95_Lower = ci.lower, CI95_Upper = ci.upper)

eff90_binary <- pe90_binary %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(CI90_Lower = ci.lower, CI90_Upper = ci.upper)

eff_df_binary <- eff95_binary %>%

      ind_goods  = "Indirect: Goods",
      ind_house  = "Indirect: House Materials",

    # Order: show each mediator, then totals & direct
```

```{r Vanilla Harvest Loss SEM}

# ---- 1) Define the SEM ----
model_multi_lost <- '
  # Two vanilla variables (parallel “exposures”)
  log_vanilla_pct_loss ~ d1*cert_member + villageSarahandrano + villageMandena
  log_vanilla          ~ d2*cert_member + villageSarahandrano + villageMandena

  # Mediators (now depend on BOTH vanilla variables + cert_member)
  log_commercial ~ a1*log_vanilla_pct_loss + a3*log_vanilla +
                   g1*cert_member + villageSarahandrano + villageMandena
  house_sol      ~ a2*log_vanilla_pct_loss + a4*log_vanilla +
                   g2*cert_member + villageSarahandrano + villageMandena

  # Allow vanilla variables to covary (recommended)
  log_vanilla_pct_loss ~~ log_vanilla

  # Mediators covary
  log_commercial ~~ house_sol

  # Outcome
  hunted_trapped ~ b1*log_commercial + b2*house_sol +
                   c1*log_vanilla_pct_loss + c2*log_vanilla +
                   h1*cert_member +
                   villageSarahandrano + villageMandena + gender + age

  # --- Indirect effects of log_vanilla_pct_loss ---
  ind_goods_vanloss  := a1*b1
  ind_house_vanloss  := a2*b2
  ind_total_vanloss  := ind_goods_vanloss + ind_house_vanloss
  direct_vanloss     := c1
  total_vanloss      := direct_vanloss + ind_total_vanloss

  # --- Indirect effects of log_vanilla ---
  ind_goods_van      := a3*b1
  ind_house_van      := a4*b2
  ind_total_van      := ind_goods_van + ind_house_van
  direct_van         := c2
  total_van          := direct_van + ind_total_van

  # --- Indirect effects of cert_member ---
  # via mediators only
  ind_cert_goods_only := g1*b1
  ind_cert_house_only := g2*b2

  # via vanilla only (two vanilla vars)
  ind_cert_vanloss_only := d1*c1
  ind_cert_van_only     := d2*c2

  # via vanilla -> mediators (3-step; two vanilla vars)
  ind_cert_vanloss_goods := d1*a1*b1
  ind_cert_vanloss_house := d1*a2*b2
  ind_cert_van_goods     := d2*a3*b1
  ind_cert_van_house     := d2*a4*b2

  # total indirect of cert_member (all pathways except direct)
  ind_cert_total := ind_cert_goods_only + ind_cert_house_only +
                    ind_cert_vanloss_only + ind_cert_van_only +
                    ind_cert_vanloss_goods + ind_cert_vanloss_house +
                    ind_cert_van_goods + ind_cert_van_house

  # direct + total effect of cert_member
  direct_cert := h1
  total_cert  := direct_cert + ind_cert_total
'



# ---- 2) Fit the SEM ----
fit_multi_lost <- sem(
  model_multi_lost,
  data = survey_dat4x,
  ordered   = c("hunted_trapped"),
  estimator = "WLSMV"
)

# ---- 3) Inspect effects  ----
summary(fit_multi_lost, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)


# ---- 4) Plot
pe95_lost <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_lost, ci = TRUE, level = 0.95)
pe90_lost <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_lost, ci = TRUE, level = 0.90)

keep_labs <- c("ind_goods_vanloss","ind_house_vanloss","ind_total_vanloss","direct_vanloss","total_vanloss")

eff95_lost <- pe95_lost %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, est, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(Estimate = est, CI95_Lower = ci.lower, CI95_Upper = ci.upper)

eff90_lost <- pe90_lost %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(CI90_Lower = ci.lower, CI90_Upper = ci.upper)

eff_df_lost <- eff95_lost %>%
  left_join(eff90_lost, by = "label") %>%
  mutate(
    Effect = dplyr::recode(label,
      ind_goods_vanloss  = "Indirect: Goods",
      ind_house_vanloss  = "Indirect: House Materials",
      ind_total_vanloss  = "Total indirect",
      direct_vanloss     = "Direct",
      total_vanloss      = "Total"
    ),
    # Order: show each mediator, then totals & direct
    Effect = factor(
      Effect,
      levels = c("Total","Direct",  "Total indirect", "Indirect: Goods","Indirect: House Materials")
    )
  ) %>% filter(Effect != "Total indirect")

eff_df_lost <- eff_df_lost %>%
  mutate(
    Effect = dplyr::recode(label,
      ind_goods_vanloss  = "Indirect:\nGoods",
      ind_house_vanloss  = "Indirect:\nHouse Materials",
      ind_total_vanloss  = "Total\nindirect",
      direct_vanloss     = "Direct",
      total_vanloss      = "Total"
    ),
    Effect = factor(
      Effect,
      levels = c("Total","Direct", "Indirect:\nGoods","Indirect:\nHouse Materials",
                 "Total\nindirect")
    )
  )%>% filter(Effect != "Total\nindirect")


# --- 3) Plot: point estimates with 95% (wider) and 90% (narrower) CIs ---

lost_plot <- ggplot(eff_df_lost, aes(x = Effect, y = Estimate, color = Effect)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = CI95_Lower, ymax = CI95_Upper),
                linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = CI90_Lower, ymax = CI90_Upper),
                  linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs( x = NULL,
    y = "Effect of % lost vanilla harvest") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "black", "purple3", "blue"))

```

```{r Vanilla Certification SEM}

survey_dat3$cert_member[survey_dat3$cert_member=="No"] <- 0
survey_dat3$cert_member[survey_dat3$cert_member=="Yes"] <- 1
survey_dat3$cert_member <- as.numeric(survey_dat3$cert_member)


# ---- 1) Define the SEM----
model_multi_cert <- '
  # Mediators (parallel)
  log_commercial ~ a1*cert_member +  villageSarahandrano + villageMandena
  house_sol      ~ a2*cert_member +  villageSarahandrano + villageMandena
log_commercial ~~ house_sol
  # Outcome
  hunted_trapped ~ b1*log_commercial + b2*house_sol +
                   c*cert_member +  villageSarahandrano + villageMandena+ gender + age

  # Indirect effects (per mediator)
  ind_goods  := a1*b1
  ind_house  := a2*b2

  # Total indirect, direct, and total effects
  ind_total := ind_goods + ind_house 
  direct    := c
  total     := direct + ind_total
'

# ---- 2) Fit the SEM ----
fit_multi_cert <- sem(
  model_multi_cert,
  data = survey_dat3x,
  ordered   = c("hunted_trapped"),
  estimator = "WLSMV"     
)

# ---- 3) Inspect effects----
summary(fit_multi_cert, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)


# ---- 4) Plot

pe95_cert <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_cert, ci = TRUE, level = 0.95)
pe90_cert <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_cert, ci = TRUE, level = 0.90)

keep_labs <- c("ind_goods","ind_house","ind_total","direct","total")

eff95_cert <- pe95_cert %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, est, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(Estimate = est, CI95_Lower = ci.lower, CI95_Upper = ci.upper)

eff90_cert <- pe90_cert %>%
  filter(label %in% keep_labs) %>%
  select(label, ci.lower, ci.upper) %>%
  rename(CI90_Lower = ci.lower, CI90_Upper = ci.upper)

eff_df_cert <- eff95_cert %>%
  left_join(eff90_cert, by = "label") %>%
  mutate(
    Effect = dplyr::recode(label,
      ind_goods  = "Indirect: Goods",
      ind_house  = "Indirect: House Materials",
      ind_total  = "Total indirect",
      direct     = "Direct",
      total      = "Total"
    ),
    # Order: show each mediator, then totals & direct
    Effect = factor(
      Effect,
      levels = c("Total","Direct",  "Total indirect", "Indirect: Goods","Indirect: House Materials")
    )
  ) %>% filter(Effect != "Total indirect")

eff_df_cert <- eff_df_cert %>%
  mutate(
    Effect = dplyr::recode(label,
      ind_goods  = "Indirect:\nGoods",
      ind_house  = "Indirect:\nHouse Materials",
      ind_total  = "Total\nindirect",
      direct     = "Direct",
      total      = "Total"
    ),
    Effect = factor(
      Effect,
      levels = c("Total","Direct", "Indirect:\nGoods","Indirect:\nHouse Materials",
                 "Total\nindirect")
    )
  )%>% filter(Effect != "Total\nindirect")


# --- 3) Plot: point estimates with 95% (wider) and 90% (narrower) CIs ---

cert_plot <- ggplot(eff_df_cert, aes(x = Effect, y = Estimate, color = Effect)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = CI95_Lower, ymax = CI95_Upper), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = CI90_Lower, ymax = CI90_Upper), linewidth = 1.5) +

  labs(x = NULL, y = "Effect of vanilla certification") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "black", "purple3", "blue"))
```

```{r Amount Harvested Plot}
# --- Settings ---
goods_var <- "log_commercial"
house_var <- "house_sol"
vanilla   <- "log_vanilla"
outcome   <- "hunted_trapped"
controls  <- c("villageSarahandrano","villageMandena", "season","gender","age")
alpha     <- 0.1

# --- 1) Extract regressions (unstandardized to match summary) ---
pe <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi, standardized = FALSE)
V  <- vcov(fit_multi)
edges <- subset(pe, op == "~")

# ONLY drop paths *from* gender, age, and village (keep 'season')
drop_from <- c("gender","age","villageSarahandrano","villageMandena")
edges <- edges[!(edges$rhs %in% drop_from), ]

# --- 2) Keep BOTH significant and non-significant; mark significance ---
edges$signif <- edges$pvalue < alpha

# labels: stars only for significant
stars <- cut(edges$pvalue,
             breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, Inf),
             labels = c("***","**","*","+",""), right = FALSE)
edges$lab <- paste0(round(edges$est, 2), stars)

# default styling
edges$col     <- "black"
edges$fontcol <- "black"
edges$pw      <- 1.6
edges$style   <- "solid"

# color Goods vs House direct paths
is_goods <- edges$rhs == goods_var | edges$lhs == goods_var
is_house <- edges$rhs == house_var | edges$lhs == house_var
edges$col[is_goods]     <- "purple3"
edges$fontcol[is_goods] <- "purple3"
edges$col[is_house]     <- "blue"
edges$fontcol[is_house] <- "blue"

# --- 2b) Apply alpha=0.2 to NON-significant direct paths ---
add_alpha <- function(col, a = 0.2) {
  rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(col) / 255
  sprintf("#%02X%02X%02X%02X",
          round(rgb[1,]*255), round(rgb[2,]*255), round(rgb[3,]*255), round(a*255))
}
edges$acol     <- edges$col
edges$afontcol <- edges$fontcol
edges$acol[!edges$signif]     <- add_alpha(edges$col[!edges$signif],     0.2)
edges$afontcol[!edges$signif] <- add_alpha(edges$fontcol[!edges$signif], 0.2)

# --- 3) Helper to fetch a path's estimate/variance/row index (unchanged) ---
get_path <- function(lhs, rhs) {
  r <- which(pe$op == "~" & pe$lhs == lhs & pe$rhs == rhs)
  if (length(r) != 1) return(NULL)
  list(est = pe$est[r], var = V[r, r], idx = r)
}

# --- 4) Significant indirect effects only (unchanged logic) ---
ind_edges <- list()

indirect_edge <- function(via, via_col) {
  # vanilla -> via -> outcome
  a <- get_path(via, vanilla)
  b <- get_path(outcome, via)
  if (is.null(a) || is.null(b)) return(NULL)

  cov_ab <- V[a$idx, b$idx]
  est <- a$est * b$est
  var <- (b$est^2) * a$var + (a$est^2) * b$var + 2 * a$est * b$est * cov_ab
  se  <- sqrt(max(var, 0))
  z   <- if (se > 0) est / se else NA_real_
  p   <- if (is.na(z)) NA_real_ else 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))

  # label with stars
  stars <- if (is.na(p)) "" else cut(p,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, Inf),
    labels = c("***","**","*","+",""), right = FALSE
  )
  lab <- paste0(round(est, 2), stars)

  # alpha-aware colors for non-sig
  add_alpha <- function(col, a = 0.2) {
    rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(col) / 255
    sprintf("#%02X%02X%02X%02X",
            round(rgb[1,]*255), round(rgb[2,]*255), round(rgb[3,]*255), round(a*255))
  }
  sig <- (!is.na(p)) && (p < alpha)
  col_use     <- if (sig) via_col else add_alpha(via_col, 0.2)
  fontcol_use <- col_use

  data.frame(
    rhs     = vanilla,
    lhs     = outcome,
    lab     = lab,
    col     = col_use,
    fontcol = fontcol_use,
    pw      = 1.6,
    style   = "dashed",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Indirect via Goods (purple) and via House (blue) — both included
ind_goods <- indirect_edge(goods_var, "purple3")
ind_house <- indirect_edge(house_var, "blue")

ind_edges <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), list(ind_goods, ind_house)))

  ind_edges <- data.frame(rhs=character(), lhs=character(), lab=character(),

                          style=character(), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}

# --- 5) Nodes (unchanged except later we use all vars) ---

labels <- c(
  log_commercial = "Goods",
  house_sol      = "House Materials",
  log_vanilla    = "log(Vanilla harvest)",
  hunted_trapped = "Hunted/Trapped",
  cert_member    = "Certification\nMember"
)
node_lab <- setNames(vars, vars)
for (nm in names(labels)) { if (nm %in% vars) node_lab[nm] <- labels[[nm]] }

node_fill   <- setNames(rep("white", length(vars)), vars)
node_font   <- setNames(rep("black", length(vars)), vars)
node_border <- setNames(rep("black", length(vars)), vars)
if (goods_var %in% vars) {
  node_fill[goods_var]   <- "purple3"
  node_font[goods_var]   <- "white"
  node_border[goods_var] <- "purple3"
}
if (house_var %in% vars) {
  node_fill[house_var]   <- "blue"
  node_font[house_var]   <- "white"
  node_border[house_var] <- "blue"
}

esc <- function(x) gsub('"','\\"', x)

# --- 6) Combine edges (NOW with bidirectional arrows for house_materials) ---
direct_edges <- data.frame(
  rhs     = edges$rhs,
  lhs     = edges$lhs,
  lab     = edges$lab,
  col     = edges$acol,        # alpha-aware colors
  fontcol = edges$afontcol,    # alpha-aware font colors
  pw      = edges$pw,
  style   = edges$style,
  dir     = "forward",         # NEW
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Make any edge touching House Materials bidirectional (arrowheads both ends)
direct_edges$dir[direct_edges$rhs == house_var | direct_edges$lhs == house_var] <- "both"

# Indirect edges need a dir column too so rbind works
if (nrow(ind_edges) > 0) ind_edges$dir <- "forward"

all_edges <- rbind(direct_edges, ind_edges)

# --- 7) Build DOT & render ---
dot <- paste0(
  'digraph G {\n',
  '  graph [rankdir=LR, splines=spline, nodesep="0.4", ranksep="0.6"];\n',
  '  node  [shape=box, fontname="Helvetica", style=filled];\n',
  '  edge  [fontname="Helvetica"];\n',
  paste(sprintf('  "%s" [label="%s", fillcolor="%s", fontcolor="%s", color="%s"];',
                vars, esc(unname(node_lab[vars])),
                unname(node_fill[vars]), unname(node_font[vars]), unname(node_border[vars])),
        collapse = "\n"), '\n',
  paste(sprintf(
    '  "%s" -> "%s" [label="%s", color="%s", fontcolor="%s", penwidth=%s, style="%s", dir="%s", arrowtail="normal"];',
    all_edges$rhs, all_edges$lhs, esc(all_edges$lab),
    all_edges$col, all_edges$fontcol, all_edges$pw, all_edges$style, all_edges$dir
  ), collapse = "\n"),
  '\n}'
)
```

```{r Vanilla Certification Plot}
             style="dashed", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}

ind_goods <- indirect_edge(goods_var,"purple3")
ind_house <- indirect_edge(house_var,"blue")
ind_edges <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), list(ind_goods, ind_house)))
if (is.null(ind_edges)) {
  ind_edges <- data.frame(rhs=character(), lhs=character(), lab=character(),
                          col=character(), fontcol=character(), pw=numeric(),
                          style=character(), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}

# --- 5) Nodes ---
vars <- sort(unique(c(edges$lhs, edges$rhs, ind_edges$lhs, ind_edges$rhs)))
labels <- c(
  log_commercial = "Goods",
  house_sol      = "House Materials",
  cert_member    = "Certification\nMember",
  hunted_trapped = "Hunted/Trapped"
)
node_lab <- setNames(vars, vars)
for (nm in names(labels)) if (nm %in% vars) node_lab[nm] <- labels[[nm]]

node_fill <- setNames(rep("white", length(vars)), vars)
node_font <- setNames(rep("black", length(vars)), vars)
node_border <- setNames(rep("black", length(vars)), vars)
if (goods_var %in% vars) {
  node_fill[goods_var] <- "purple3"; node_font[goods_var] <- "white"; node_border[goods_var] <- "purple3"
}
if (house_var %in% vars) {
  node_fill[house_var] <- "blue"; node_font[house_var] <- "white"; node_border[house_var] <- "blue"
}
esc <- function(x) gsub('"','\\"', x)

# --- 6) Combine edges (WITH bidirectional arrows for house_materials) ---
direct_edges <- data.frame(
  rhs=edges$rhs, lhs=edges$lhs, lab=edges$lab,
  col=edges$acol, fontcol=edges$afontcol,
  pw=edges$pw, style=edges$style,
  dir="forward",                    # NEW
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)

# Make ANY edge that touches House Materials bidirectional (arrowheads both ends)
direct_edges$dir[direct_edges$rhs == house_var | direct_edges$lhs == house_var] <- "both"

# Indirect edges need a dir column too so rbind works
if (nrow(ind_edges) > 0) ind_edges$dir <- "forward"

all_edges <- rbind(direct_edges, ind_edges)

# --- 7) Build DOT & render ---
dot <- paste0(
  'digraph G {\n',
  '  graph [rankdir=LR, splines=spline, nodesep="0.4", ranksep="0.6"];\n',
  '  node [shape=box, fontname="Helvetica", style=filled];\n',
  '  edge [fontname="Helvetica"];\n',
  paste(sprintf('  "%s" [label="%s", fillcolor="%s", fontcolor="%s", color="%s"];',
                vars, esc(unname(node_lab[vars])),
                unname(node_fill[vars]), unname(node_font[vars]), unname(node_border[vars])),
        collapse="\n"), '\n',
  paste(sprintf(
    '  "%s" -> "%s" [label="%s", color="%s", fontcolor="%s", penwidth=%s, style="%s", dir="%s", arrowtail="normal"];',
    all_edges$rhs, all_edges$lhs, esc(all_edges$lab),
    all_edges$col, all_edges$fontcol, all_edges$pw, all_edges$style, all_edges$dir
  ), collapse="\n"),
  '\n}'
)

cert_path <- grViz(dot)


```

```{r}
results_binary <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_binary, standardized = TRUE)
results_table_binary <- results_binary[, c("lhs", "op", "rhs", "est", "se", "pvalue")]
results_table_binary$Model <- "Binary"

results_amount <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi, standardized = TRUE)
results_table_amount <- results_amount[, c("lhs", "op", "rhs", "est", "se", "pvalue")]
results_table_amount$Model <- "Amount Harvested"

results_cert <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_cert, standardized = TRUE)
results_table_cert <- results_cert[, c("lhs", "op", "rhs", "est", "se", "pvalue")]
results_table_cert$Model <- "Certification Program"

results_lost <- parameterEstimates(fit_multi_lost, standardized = TRUE)
results_table_lost <- results_lost[, c("lhs", "op", "rhs", "est", "se", "pvalue")]
results_table_lost$Model <- "Harvest Lost"

results_combined <- rbind(results_table_binary, results_table_amount, results_table_cert, results_table_lost)
colnames(results_combined) <- c("Dependent Variable", "Operator", "Predictor Variable", "Estimate", "Standard Error", "P-Value", "Model")

results_combined <- results_combined %>% dplyr::select(Model, `Dependent Variable`:`P-Value`)

write.csv(results_combined, "sem_results_combined.csv")
```

```{r}
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +

  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c( "purple3", "blue"))
```
